home.aboutText: {name} sits on a quiet street above Lake Garda, ten minutes on foot from the ferry and the old town. Mornings on the terrace, afternoons on the water and long dinners in the garden: this is the place to tell your own property's story.

info.heading: The House
info.intro: Three bedrooms, two terraces and a view of the water from almost every window. Everything a family or a group of friends needs for a slow week by the lake.

parking.text: A private space for one car, a few steps from the door.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi
wifi.text: Fast fibre broadband throughout the house, with a quiet desk for work.
